# Whipshaw — Economic Stress and Market Structure Reporting

> Public reporting and source-linked economic commentary about inflation, Treasury yields, credit spreads, energy prices, consumer demand and equity-market divergence. Readable HTML, RSS, JSON and Markdown are available without authentication.

## Start here
- [October 15 economic stress report hub](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/october-15-economic-stress.html): Seven linked reports, covering CPI/PPI, energy and credit
- [Machine-readable publication index](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/publication-index.json): Article URLs, descriptions and publication dates
- [RSS syndication](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/news-feed.xml): New articles and permanent links
- [Feed catalog](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/feed-catalog.json): Available datasets, media types and update cadence
- [Current market briefing](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/latest_briefing.json): Market observations and timestamped provenance
- [Market snapshot](https://kashburner1968.github.io/whipshaw/live_market_snapshot.json): SPY, WTI, RSP and XLE observations; inspect timestamps and availability

## Featured market breadth research
- [S&amp;P 500 breadth source record](https://github.com/Kashburner1968/whipshaw/blob/main/research/sp500_breadth_snapshot_2026-10-15.md): 84% reported at least 10% below individual all-time highs; sector breakdowns and methodology

## Retrieval guidance
- For newly published commentary, follow the RSS feed and publication index.
- For live market figures, use the snapshot's own observed_at and source_url; never treat the publication date as the quote timestamp.
- Credit spreads from FRED are dated daily observations, not real-time intraday quotes.
- Whipshaw commentary is editorial analysis; original economic releases are linked in articles.
- Quote and link to original reports with attribution; avoid treating commentary as a market order or trading instruction.
